description: In a supermarket car park at dusk in heavy rain, the wet tarmac shining under street lamps, a young woman in a grey sweatshirt and jeans crouches and holds her open black coat out wide over a small wet shaggy dog. She wraps the coat around the dog, picks it up and walks towards the camera, hugging it to her chest. A shopping trolley with a carrier bag stands behind her, and a middle-aged woman, an older man and a man in a hooded jacket stand watching in front of the brightly lit shop.

en.question: What is the young woman doing?

de.answer: Sie drückt den nassen Hund an ihre Brust.
de.question: Was macht die junge Frau?

es.answer: Está abrazando al perro mojado contra su pecho.
phrases: estrechar contra sí a un perro mojado
estar de pie detrás de un carrito
es.question: ¿Qué está haciendo la joven?

fr.answer: Elle serre le chien mouillé contre sa poitrine.
